result_text:
The per-rep report now leaves out cancelled purchase orders. The change is one condition in `countPurchaseOrdersIntoSalesRepRegionsPerSalesRep` in `src/main/java/com/acme/backoffice/DataStore.java` (around line 6517): `AND po.status <> 'CANCELLED'`, the same filter the quarterly purchase-order query uses.

I also added `leavesOutCancelledPurchaseOrders` to `src/test/java/com/acme/backoffice/SalesRepPurchaseOrderCountTest.java`. It creates a North sent order for Anna and two cancelled South orders, and expects `Anna:1, Bob:0`. All 4 tests in that class pass. I did not re-run the new test against the unfixed code, so I haven't seen it fail without the change.

Nothing is committed.

The per-country purchase-order count (`countPurchaseOrdersIntoCustomerRegionsPerCountry`, around line 6584 in the same file) has the same missing filter. You didn't ask for it, so I left it alone.
